📌 Pack to Chain to Team is not climbed once. Rotation matters too: if the same person is always the first link, the group learns the modes but not the participation.

g.title: 📌 One standing group. The unit of design is the mode, not the membership — you re-wire these five, you do not replace them.
📌 +ln 5 = +1.61 logits. Each member must try something nobody else is trying. Failure costs the pack nothing, so being a distinct part is safe.
📌 -ln 5 = -1.61 logits. Five links is a real referral pathway. One break loses everything, so each link carries the entire outcome.
📌 Needs only +0.40 logits over the problem at N=5. Nothing happens till all agree.
📌 Follett's first clause. Every person spends the pack phase holding a piece nobody else holds, and watches the outcome assembled out of those separate pieces.
📌 Follett's second clause. Nobody can be a fraction of the result — the entire outcome lives in each link, so each person carries all of it.

a.data-title: THE WHOLE IS IN EVERY PART

text.tspan: THE WHOLE IS IN EVERY PART

g.title: 📌 Not compromise, which splits the difference between parts. The decision is at once one thing the group holds and something each member holds entirely.

📌 The whole in every part and every part in the whole. Available only to a group that has had both of the other experiences — which is why a Team assembled without a Pack and a Chain behind it has no materials to synthesise, and is a mob.
